verdict.rationale: Asaas has one documented native, event-driven automation: automatic notifications sent before and after a charge's due date, over channels the user chooses (WhatsApp, email, SMS, voice robot). That is a narrow, preset rule rather than a general way to define rules that trigger actions. Webhooks are developer building blocks for constructing automation, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: a general user-definable rule/trigger engine, arbitrary event-to-action mapping, conditions and multiple action types, and detailed docs or hands-on corroboration of the notification rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Envie notificações automáticas antes e depois do vencimento. Você escolhe os canais: WhatsApp, e-mail, SMS ou robô de voz.
